name: net.http.test
doc:
net.http.test (Go's net/http/httptest): a real server on a free
loopback port (NewServer, NewTLSServer, NewH2CServer) with a client set
up for it, a response recorder (NewRecorder) and test requests
(NewRequest) to call a Handler directly (Serve).

items.name: NewH2CServer
items.doc: A test server speaking HTTP/2 with prior knowledge (and HTTP/1.1).
items.summary: A test server speaking HTTP/2 with prior knowledge (and HTTP/1.1).

items.name: NewRecorder
items.doc:
A response recorder: pass it to Handler.Serve and inspect Status,
Headers and Body afterwards (Flush only counts: res.Flushes()).
items.summary: A response recorder: pass it to Handler.Serve and inspect Status, Headers and Body afterwards (Flush only counts: res.Flushes()).

items.name: NewRequest
items.signature: func NewRequest(method string, target string, body string) *net.http.Request
items.doc:
A server request for calling a Handler directly: target is a path
("/a?b=1") or a URL ("https://example.com/a"); Host defaults to
example.com, RemoteAddr is 192.0.2.1:1234, a body sets Content-Length.
items.summary: A server request for calling a Handler directly: target is a path ("/a?b=1") or a URL ("https://example.com/a"); Host defaults to example.com, RemoteAddr is 192.0.2.1:1234, a body sets Content-Length.

items.name: NewServer
items.doc: A test server for h on 127.0.0.1 (a free port).
items.summary: A test server for h on 127.0.0.1 (a free port).

items.name: NewTLSServer
items.doc: A test HTTPS server (self-signed certificate, ALPN h2 and http/1.1).
items.summary: A test HTTPS server (self-signed certificate, ALPN h2 and http/1.1).

items.name: Serve
items.doc:
Serves req with h into a new recorder; a handler error becomes a 500
response like the server's.
items.summary: Serves req with h into a new recorder; a handler error becomes a 500 response like the server's.

members.name: TLS
members.doc: HTTPS with a self-signed certificate for localhost and 127.0.0.1.
members.summary: HTTPS with a self-signed certificate for localhost and 127.0.0.1.

members.name: H2C
members.doc: HTTP/2 with prior knowledge on plain TCP (server and client).
members.summary: HTTP/2 with prior knowledge on plain TCP (server and client).

members.name: DisableHTTP2
members.doc: The client of the server does not use HTTP/2 over TLS.
members.summary: The client of the server does not use HTTP/2 over TLS.

items.name: Server
items.doc:
Server is a running test server. URL is its base ("http://127.0.0.1:port"
or https); Client talks to it (TLS servers: the test certificate is
trusted, ALPN h2; H2C servers: HTTP/2 with prior knowledge).
items.summary: Server is a running test server.

members.name: Close
members.doc:
Stops the server (Shutdown) and waits for it; idle client
connections are closed first.
members.summary: Stops the server (Shutdown) and waits for it; idle client connections are closed first.
